name: Whole body
summary: Pick a place to zoom into: the blood, the organs where immune cells develop (bone marrow, thymus) or meet invaders (lymph nodes, spleen), or the skin, the barrier where many infections begin.
description: A front view of a human figure in outline. Six labelled markers sit on it: lymph nodes at the neck, armpits and groin; the thymus in the upper chest; blood vessels and the heart; the spleen on the left of the abdomen; skin on the forearm; and bone marrow in both thigh bones.
